newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: WEAKER SLOVAKOFARMA SHARES PULL SLOVAK SAX LOWER.
newsitem.headline: WEAKER SLOVAKOFARMA SHARES PULL SLOVAK SAX LOWER.

text.p: The Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) lost ground on Monday in sluggish trading, pulled lower by average price losses to drug maker Slovakofarma.
Slovakofarma's average price -- used for calculating the SAX -- eased by 1.8 percent during continuous trading, pulling the SAX index down 0.32 points to 168.10.
The firm's shares closed up 20 crowns to 4,220, though only seven shares changed hands on the BSE floor.
Steel maker VSZ, the most liquid stock on the main listed floor over the past few weeks and oil refinery Slovnaft, the most-heavily weighted issue in the index, did not match any deals on Monday.
Weaker first half results posted by some major companies recently so far do not appear to have affected trading, as most major stocks were quiet.
Overall volume fell to 157,720 shares from 260,995 on Friday while turnover eased to 34.11 million crowns from 171.30 million. Both volume and turnover were generated mostly through direct deals.
